name: Nitin Bisht
profile: My research focuses on the statistical foundations of trustworthy machine learning, with applications to recommender systems and large language models. I am particularly interested in uncertainty quantification, statistical risk control, and continual learning under distribution shifts.

publications.title: FRAG: Fair Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLM-based Sequential Recommendation
publications.summary: LLM recommenders can repeatedly give some groups of items too little visibility. FRAG tracks this imbalance and changes which items the model considers next, improving exposure for overlooked groups while keeping recommendations relevant.

publications.title: ALIGN-Rec: Continual Recommendation under Heterogeneous Unlearning Requests
publications.summary: When a recommender keeps learning, information a user asked it to forget can start influencing its predictions again. ALIGN-Rec controls later updates so the system can learn from new activity while limiting the return of deleted information, without retraining from scratch.
publications.tags: continual learning machine unlearning privacy recommendation

publications.title: MIDA: Multi-Interest Decoding with Adaptive Aggregation for Session-based Recommendation
publications.summary: Longer browsing sessions can make recommendations worse when models focus too heavily on recent clicks. MIDA identifies the different interests across a session and combines earlier choices with recent activity to improve the next recommendation.

publications.title: CARE: Adaptive Calibration for Reliable Recommendations
publications.summary: People's interests change, so recommendations can become less reliable after a model is deployed. CARE tracks these changes and adjusts how many items it recommends, keeping lists compact with statistical guarantees on recommendation quality.
publications.tags: uncertainty calibration risk control distribution shift

publications.title: CORAL: Uncertainty-Aware Regulation of Exposure Concentration in Recommender Systems
publications.summary: Uses uncertainty-aware risk estimates to regulate exposure concentration over repeated recommendations.
publications.tags: risk control fairness sequential decision exposure

publications.title: SCAU-REC: Subspace-Constrained Adapter Updates for LLM-Based Recommendations
publications.summary: Detects preference shifts and constrains adapter updates to reduce interference with retained preferences.
